assignedEnvironment.caption: Assigned environment
assignedEnvironment.help: This name is set by an administrator of the enrolment module: it is the authoritative one, not the name this stack declares about itself.
assignedEnvironment.none: The enrolment module has not linked us to any environment of its registry.
assignedEnvironment.neverKnown: The enrolment module could not be reached, and no environment has ever been read: which one is assigned to us is unknown.
assignedEnvironment.stale: Last known value, read on {{date}}: the enrolment module could not be reached to refresh it.
assignedEnvironment.unavailable: The assigned environment could not be read.

peering.lead: This environment pairs with a single enrolment module, which is the sole authority over its device assignment.

pending.where: The code is shown on the « Pairing » screen of {{url}}, next to the request carrying this environment's URL. It renews every thirty seconds.

repair.body: The current pairing will be replaced. Devices the previous enrolment module assigned to this environment will no longer be assigned by it.

storages.title: Storage spaces
storages.unreadable: The storage spaces could not be read. See the service logs.
storages.none: The served version declares no storage space.
storages.notApplied: This space's table is not created yet: no object can be searched in it.
storages.noIndex: No declared index: only the functional key can be filtered on.

refusals.declaration_illisible: This space's declaration cannot be read.
refusals.modele_invalide: The declared model is not a valid “domain/name”.
refusals.modele_absent: The declared model is missing from the served version.
refusals.nom_invalide: This space's name cannot name a table.
refusals.propriete_inconnue: An indexed property does not exist in the model — fix the index in the configuration.
refusals.propriete_non_scalaire: An indexed property is not a single value: a container, or a path crossing an array.
refusals.colonne_en_collision: Two indexed properties would give the same column.
refusals.trop_de_colonnes: An index declares more than three columns, or none.
refusals.nom_d_index_invalide: An index name cannot name an index in the database.
refusals.table_de_forme_inattendue: A table of this name exists and does not have the expected shape: nothing was changed.
refusals.changement_de_type_requis: The served version asks for a type change on an existing column: it was not applied.

searchErrors.propriete_non_filtrable: “{{property}}” cannot be filtered on: only the functional key and the declared indexes can.
searchErrors.propriete_non_triable: “{{property}}” is not a property to sort on.
searchErrors.valeur_hors_type: The given value is not of this property's type.
searchErrors.prefixe_sur_valeur_non_textuelle: “{{property}}” is not text: “starts with” does not apply to it.
searchErrors.unexpected: The search failed. See the service logs.

apiKeys.title: Ingestion API keys
apiKeys.intro: A key lets a third-party system push data to the sources granted to it. This environment manages its own: no other module knows them.
apiKeys.unreadable: This environment's keys could not be read.
apiKeys.none: No key has been issued yet.
apiKeys.noSource: The served version declares no source: there is nothing to grant, so no key to issue.
apiKeys.label: Label
apiKeys.onlyOnce: Copy it now: it is shown once and cannot be read again.
apiKeys.missingSources: Granted on a source the served version no longer declares: {{sources}}

errors.vide: Pick at least one source: a key that opens nothing is useless.
errors.source_inconnue: The served version does not declare source “{{source}}”.
errors.invalide: This label is not accepted: a single line, 120 characters at most.
errors.unknown: The key could not be issued.

ingestion.title: Ingestion service
ingestion.unreadable: The ingestion service state could not be read.
ingestion.noVersion: No configuration version is served: no source is declared, and no entry point exists.
ingestion.noEndpoint: The served version declares no source entry: nothing is exposed.
ingestion.notServed: Mode “{{mode}}” is declared but not served yet: a deposit will be refused.
ingestion.noBulkQueue: Bulk deposits are not served yet: there is no queue to watch.

calls.title: Recent calls
calls.unreadable: The call journal could not be read.

methods.unreadable: The service methods could not be read.
methods.title: Methods
methods.none: No method: the served version declares no entry for this source.
methods.notServed: This method is declared by the configuration and is not served yet: a deposit would be refused.
methods.failed: The trial could not be sent. {{code}}
methods.keyRevoked: The key the back-office uses for its trials has been revoked. Issue a new one to try again; the old one stays visible on the keys page, with the deposits it carried.
methods.contract: Responses declared by the published contract
methods.modele_absent: The served version does not carry the input model {{model}}: the expected shape cannot be shown.
methods.modele_invalide: The input model {{model}} is malformed in the source declaration.
methods.fileHelp: The import's outcome is in the call log below.

signature.modelSchema: Input model {{model}}, as validation uses it
signature.contractSchema: Body the contract declares for this address

source.intro: An ingestion source: what it promises to whoever wires it, and what it has received.

contract.specHelp: The very one versioned in the repository: enough to generate a client.
